---
title: "Structured Authors"
author:
  - name: Norah Jones
    orcid: 0000-0002-1825-0097
    email: norah@example.com
    url: https://example.com/norah
    corresponding: true
    degrees:
      - PhD
    affiliations:
      - name: Carnegie Mellon University
        department: School of Music
  - name: Bill Malone
    affiliations:
      - name: University of Texas
        url: https://utexas.edu
# Title-block parity corpus (bd-gx9cic8z). P2 (bd-ez0hiowa): the full
# structured author model renders as Q1's two-column authors /
# affiliations grid (`.quarto-title-meta-author`), with url-linked
# names, degrees after the name, an email icon anchor, and an ORCID
# badge anchor (inline SVG per design decision Q8). With affiliations
# present, the plain `.quarto-title-meta` grid carries no authors cell.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "header#title-block-header.quarto-title-block.default",
            "div.quarto-title > h1.title",
            "div.quarto-title-meta-author > div.quarto-title-meta-heading",
            "div.quarto-title-meta-author > div.quarto-title-meta-contents > p.author",
            "div.quarto-title-meta-author > div.quarto-title-meta-contents > p.affiliation",
            "p.author > a[href='https://example.com/norah']",
            "a.quarto-title-author-email[href='mailto:norah@example.com'] > svg",
            "a.quarto-title-author-orcid[href='https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097'] > svg",
            "p.affiliation > a[href='https://utexas.edu']",
          ]
        - ["div.quarto-title-meta div.quarto-title-meta-contents > p"]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            "Norah Jones, PhD</a>",
            "Bill Malone",
            "Carnegie Mellon University",
            "University of Texas",
            'quarto-title-meta-heading">Authors<',
            'quarto-title-meta-heading">Affiliations<',
          ]
        - ["truetrue"]
---

Body.
